d:
This is a fan work of the artist Urakan

https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/6352
https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/list/=/article=maker/id=72746/

Hi all,

lately I have been animating some of Urakan's work using
the animation models on comfyui.
When I post these works I see comments from people
wishing that they could use ai to generate Urakan style
works of their own,

well....you can! (sort of)

While browsing different models and workflows I came
across the model Illustrious xl, its a model that can be
used to generate some pretty decent anime style art.

But more importantly I found that someone has trained
a lora based on Urakan's work. So by combining the
model and the lora I have been able to generate some
interesting Urakan style images.

It has low vram requirements so easy to use and can
generate images very quickly. It gave me an idea to
try and make a mini comic using the model and lora.

so this is a quick attempt at one, there's still some
issues and I had to do some manual editing here
and there but I feel the results are promising.

model name: Illustrious-XL-v2.0.safetensors
lora name: ill_urakan_v1.safetensors

(google the names and you will find the download files)

anyway, here it is...
n: [Misc] Kyouko's emergency sex training - Urakan style fan work [AI Generated]
